text: maya: quick check — I noticed when you pin a model version in the compare table the performance badges sometimes disappear from the right-hand column. Can folks confirm? jonathan: yeah saw that too in the latest build. badges exist on the catalog row but vanish in the compare modal if a version is pinned. aisha: repro steps? i tried: open catalog > select two models > pin version on model A > open compare. badges gone. rob: likely a props plumbing issue: pinning swaps the model variant ID and our compare view fetch uses the unpinned id for badge lookup. liz: accessibility nits too — when you keyboard into the pinned row the focus outline is faint and badge tooltip isn’t reachable by keyboard. contrast ~2.8:1 for the badge bg on hover which fails 3:1. designbot: automated note: mockups updated -> https://figma.com/s/example (see frame: compare/pinned-badges) maya: two threads here: 1) badges should reflect pinned variant always (propagation), 2) keyboard + a11y for badge tooltips. priority? jonathan: propagation is P0 — product teams expect metrics to follow pinned version. a11y is P1 but quick win. aisha: proposed fix — in compare-view component, derive badgeKey from `pinnedVariantId || mainVariantId` and hit badge service with that. small change. rob: agree. also add a memoized mapping so we don't re-request badges for identical variant ids during toggles. reduces flicker. liz: for a11y: make badges focusable `tabindex=0`, add `role=button` for tooltip toggles, and expose full text in sr-only span e.g. "Latency: 12ms (pinned)". update color token to `--badge-bg-strong` to hit 3:1. maya: copy tweak: change tooltip headline from "Perf" to "Performance (pinned)" when pinned, and suffix badge alt text with "pinned version". jonathan: note for QA: check compare export CSV — columns should use the pinned variant ids (not the originally selected). rob: I'll open a PR for the badge lookup + memoization. ETA EOD tomorrow. liz: i'll update the a11y guidelines and add testcases to storybook — keyboard + screenreader checks. maya: thanks all. ACTION: rob PR references this thread; liz adds story tests; aisha to verify once merged. ping me for release notes copy. :thumbsup: jonathan: tiny UX quibble — when both rows are pinned we should show a subtle divider between pinned state and baseline, maybe a small pin icon next to the badge header to avoid confusion. maya: good call. put a small pin icon + `title=\"Pinned variant\"` for clarity. aisha: logged follow-up ticket for that nuance (product-1482). maya: closing loop: timeline — patch + storybook tests merged -> QA -> release next minor. I'll include a short blurb in changelog re: pinned badge consistency and keyboard fixes. rob: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/842 (draft) liz: story: https://storybook.redwood.ai/?path=/story/compare--pinned-badges maya: awesome. thanks team!
